description: Share visitor attempts to rename the session. Java target returns HTTP 403 with code SHARE_PERMISSION_DENIED (ProblemDetail). This is a deliberate divergence from Node, which currently permits the rename.
nodeBaselineNotes: Divergence authorised by ADR-0001. Node returns HTTP 200 here; the Java target hard-denies share visitors. Operator may set datastoria.session-share.allow-write=true to temporarily restore Node behaviour during the P3 cutover window.

body.title: Share visitor may not mutate this session
body.detail: Share codes are read-only by default; see ADR-0001.
